capabilities.reason: Offline construction only: no model call, tool execution or external service verification.

description: Default tool for code edits. Supports multi-file changes in a single call. Provide a list of structured edits, each specifying a file path, action (replace/add), and the exact text to change. Paths are resolved by the current workspace access policy. Set dry_run=true to validate and preview without writing files. Use edit_file only for small exact replacements on a single file.

function.name: apply_patch

dry_run.description: Validate and summarize the patch without writing files.

edits.description: List of edits to apply. Each edit specifies a file and the change to make.

new_text.description: Text to replace with or append. Required for replace and add.

old_text.description: Exact text to search for in the file. Required for replace.

path.description: Path to the file to edit. Relative paths resolve against the workspace; absolute paths and '..' obey the workspace access policy.
